scripts.api:check: npm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client/src/generated.ts services/commerce-api/public/api-docs.html
scripts.api:generate: openapi-typescript openapi/commerce-api.yaml --output packages/api-client/src/generated.ts && redocly build-docs openapi/commerce-api.yaml --output services/commerce-api/public/api-docs.html && node scripts/normalize-generated.mjs
scripts.check: npm run openapi:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run openapi:lint && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi:lint && npm run openapi:validate && npm run api:check
